rationale: The papers 'Collisions in a gas-rich white dwarf planetary debris disc' (2106.09025), 'Rapid destruction of planetary debris around white dwarfs through aeolian erosion' (2011.12299), and 'Orbital migration and circularization of tidal debris by Alfvén-wave drag' (2105.06475) provide insights into the processes affecting debris disks around white dwarfs, contributing evidence relevant to the mechanisms of matter transport to the white dwarf surface.
